learning_outcomes.text: Describe the mechanical equivalent models of statics, kinematics, and kinetics. Furthermore, they know the simplifying assumptions for the models and their application limits.
Assess under which practical conditions the various equivalent models are used.
Describe real problems from mechanical engineering using kinematic and kinetic methods and solve the associated mathematical problem.
Interpret the solution of the problem and, in particular, assess whether the respective mechanical model describes the problem under consideration with sufficient accuracy.

syllabus_topics: Kinematics of the mass point and rigid body
Kinetics of the point and rigid body
Force theorem and angular momentum theorem
Design of components and processing of questions within the framework of design theory and control engineering (equations of motion).
assessment_rules: A passing grade on the exam is required for credit points. There are no prerequisites for taking the exam.
bibliography: Gross, D., Hauger, W.: Technische Mechanik 3
